newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki ups Plastono stake to 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki ups Plastono stake to 100 pct.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging materials group Huhtamaki Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had raised its stake in Portugese tray maker Plastono Embalagens Lda to 100 percent from 50 percent.
"Huhtamaki ... has acquired the outstanding 50 percent of the shares of Plastono Embalagens," it said.
"Plastono's net sales amount to approximately 800 million Portugese escudos (25 million markka)," Huhtamaki said.
The deal will enable Huhtamaki's Polarcup food packaging division to develop the highly specialised unit as an integral part of its Iberian manufacturing and sales strategy, it said.
